entry.title: Goldman Pitches $5.4 Billion Debt for Microsoft-Tied Data Center
entry.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. is gauging investor appetite for a potential $5.4 billion debt offering to help fund a Blackstone-backed QTS data center tied to Microsoft Corp., as bubble concerns push up costs for artificial intelligence infrastructure financings.

entry.title: SK Hynix Slips Ahead of Big Tech Results | Bloomberg Tech 7/29/2026
entry.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down why SK Hynix's Korean shares slumped even after reporting a six-fold jump in profit and raised capital spending to a record $31 billion. Plus, SoFi CEO Anthony Noto joins following the company's earnings topping Wall Street estimates, but showing high expenses; and big tech earnings are on the docket, with Microsoft and Meta coming next. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Goldman Says Japan’s AI Stock Trade ‘Not Broken’ After Rout
entry.summary: Goldman Sachs Japan Co. says a sharp selloff in Japan’s artificial intelligence-related stocks has created a buying opportunity, arguing that strong earnings could revive investor appetite for semiconductor shares.

entry.title: SpaceX Falls 20% Below IPO Price, Erasing $1.2 Trillion Value
entry.summary: SpaceX shares erased one-fifth of their value since the record setting debut of Elon Musk’s rocket, satellite and artificial intelligence company, as investors shunned riskier technology firms.

entry.title: Silicon Valley’s Next IPO Billionaires Are Coming. Nonprofits Are Ready for Them
entry.summary: Anthropic and OpenAI employees are expected to give generously after their companies go public. “It’s going to be a wild ride,” says one nonprofit leader.

entry.title: Why I Don't Let AI Make the Final Decision
entry.summary: AI models are probabilistic components, not decision-makers. Discover why combining machine learning with deterministic safety layers, risk gates, and human oversight is essential for building production-ready systems in robotics, fintech, and beyond.Read All

entry.title: HSBC to Hire 100 AI Specialists as Bank Sets Up Singapore Center
entry.summary: HSBC Holdings Plc is set to hire more than 100 artificial intelligence specialists in Singapore with plans to launch a global AI center in the city-state later this year as the British lender steps up investments in the technology that’s reshaping Wall Street workforces.

entry.title: Multiverse Raising Funds at $1.7 Billion Value to Cut AI Costs
entry.summary: Multiverse Computing SL is raising $570 million in a funding round that is set to boost its valuation to $1.7 billion, as investors flock to companies aiming to make it cheaper to use artificial intelligence.

entry.title: Nvidia in Talks on $250 Billion Backing for OpenAI Hub, WSJ Says
entry.summary: Nvidia Corp.’s in discussions to provide a guarantee of about $250 billion to help OpenAI lease computing from a giant data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

entry.title: China Chipmaker CXMT Jumps 472% in Debut After Blockbuster IPO
entry.summary: CXMT Corp.’s shares opened 472% higher in their Shanghai debut on Monday, making the memory chipmaker China’s largest onshore-listed company as investors flock to beneficiaries of the AI boom.
